examples.chinese: 今天天氣不冷也不熱，很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bù lěng yě bù rè, hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Today's weather is neither cold nor hot; it's very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 坐捷運又方便又舒服，我們可以坐捷運。
examples.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn yòu fāngbiàn yòu shūfu, wǒmen kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn.
examples.english: Taking the MRT is convenient and comfortable. We can take the MRT.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，頭很痛，眼睛、耳朵也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, tóu hěn tòng, yǎnjing, ěrduo yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I caught a cold; my head hurts a lot, and my eyes and ears are also uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 以前妹妹很不喜歡穿裙子，現在她覺得穿裙子很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián mèimei hěn bù xǐhuan chuān qúnzi, xiànzài tā juéde chuān qúnzi hěn shūfu.
examples.english: In the past, my younger sister really didn't like wearing skirts; now she feels that wearing skirts is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

examples.chinese: 美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。
examples.pinyin: Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.
examples.english: Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 爺爺很喜歡在海邊釣魚，看著風景、吹著海風，他覺得舒服極了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye hěn xǐhuān zài hǎibiān diào yú, kàn zhe fēngjǐng, chuī zhe hǎifēng, tā juéde shūfu jí le.
examples.english: Grandpa really likes fishing by the sea; looking at the scenery and feeling the sea breeze, he feels extremely comfortable.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 我咳嗽、頭痛，鼻子也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ késou, tóu tòng, bízi yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I have a cough and headache. Also my nose is uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 這本雜誌有點兒舊，我幫你買一本新的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì yǒudiǎnr jiù, wǒ bāng nǐ mǎi yī běn xīn de ba.
examples.english: This magazine is a bit old; let me help you buy a new one.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 那件衣服有一點兒舊，可是還可以穿很久。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu yǒu yīdiǎnr jiù, kěshì hái kěyǐ chuān hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: That piece of clothing is a little old, but can still be worn for a long time.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away.

examples.chinese: 你覺得華語好學嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde Huáyǔ hǎo xué ma?
examples.english: Do you think Chinese is easy to learn?

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 救護車開得很快，因為要救人一命。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē kāi de hěn kuài, yīnwèi yào jiù rén yī mìng.
examples.english: The ambulance drove very fast, because it needed to save a person's life.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 為了保護我們愛的人，我們得勇敢一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wǒmen ài de rén, wǒmen děi yǒnggǎn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: In order to protect the people we love, we must be a bit braver.

examples.chinese: 孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。
examples.pinyin: Zuò hǎo huánjìng bǎohù de gōngzuò, shì měi ge xiàndài rén yīng jìn de zérèn.
examples.english: Doing a good job in environmental protection is the responsibility that every modern person should fulfill.

examples.chinese: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.
examples.english: Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 大地就像我們的母親一樣，一直保護著我們。
examples.pinyin: Dàdì jiù xiàng wǒmen de mǔqīn yíyàng, yìzhí bǎohùzhe wǒmen.
examples.english: The earth is like our mother, always protecting us.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 他去當環保志工是為了保護自然環境，也是為了培養耐心。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù dāng huánbǎo zhìgōng shì wèile bǎohù zìrán huánjìng, yě shì wèile péiyǎng nàixīn.
examples.english: He went to be an environmental volunteer in order to protect the natural environment, and also to cultivate patience.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 華人和日本人都有十二生肖，十二生肖的動物也一樣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Huárén hé Rìběnrén dōu yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, shí'èr shēngxiào de dòngwù yě yíyàng ma?
examples.english: Chinese people and Japanese people both have the twelve zodiac signs; are the animals of the twelve zodiac signs also the same?

examples.chinese: 語言和科學我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán hé kēxué wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: I like both language and science.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 我想買一雙黑色的鞋子和一雙白色的襪子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng hēisè de xiézi hé yī shuāng báisè de wàzi.
examples.english: I want to buy a pair of black shoes and a pair of white socks.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 他送我花和一本書。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā hé yì běn shū.
examples.english: He gave me flowers and a book as presents.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
examples.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 我想買一些花和一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìxiē huā hé yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: I would like to buy her some flowers and a big cake.

examples.chinese: 吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng duì shìjiè dìlǐ hé lìshǐ xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, wèile dǎkāi shìyě, tā juédìng huā yì nián de shíjiān chūguó lǚxíng.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is quite interested in world geography and history. In order to broaden his vision, he decided to spend a year traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngcháng de shēnghuó zuòxī, duì shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A normal daily schedule is very important for both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 對現代人來說，電腦和網路絕對是辦公室的主要設備。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàndài rén lái shuō, diànnǎo hé wǎnglù juéduì shì bàngōngshì de zhǔyào shèbèi.
examples.english: For modern people, computers and the internet are definitely the main equipment in the office.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 這是我和你之間的祕密，你絕對不可告訴別人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ hé nǐ zhījiān de mìmì, nǐ juéduì bùkě gàosu biérén.
examples.english: This is a secret between you and me; you absolutely must not tell anyone else.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.
examples.english: Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

items.wordHook: a 禾(grain) drops into a 口(mouth) and both chew together → 和(and).

examples.chinese: 我不懂政治，對政治也沒有興趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng zhèngzhì, duì zhèngzhì yě méiyǒu xìngqù.
examples.english: I don't understand politics, and I'm not interested in politics either.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

items.key: ["B3L01-1-45","就是说嘛","就是說嘛","就是说嘛","Ph"]

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 這個網站上的圖片很多，而且都很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn shàng de túpiàn hěn duō, érqiě dōu hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: There are many pictures on this website, and they all look great.

examples.chinese: 圖書館裡的人都在看書，很安靜。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ de rén dōu zài kàn shū, hěn ānjìng.
examples.english: Everyone in the library is reading, so it is very quiet.

examples.chinese: 我要先回家，再去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān huí jiā, zài qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I want to go home first, then go to the library.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 這張地圖上有十多家餐廳，我們要去哪一家？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shàng yǒu shí duō jiā cāntīng, wǒmen yào qù nǎ yī jiā?
examples.english: There are more than ten restaurants on this map; which one do we want to go to?

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我們常常一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We often go to the library together.

examples.chinese: 昨天我們一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We went to the library together yesterday.

examples.chinese: 你幾點去圖書館？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
examples.english: What time will you go to the library?

examples.chinese: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
examples.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.
examples.english: This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully.

items.wordHook: a 囗(boundary) holds the 啚(rustic) outlands → one 圖(map).

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zuòshì fēicháng cūxīn, yīncǐ gōngsī yīzhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòngyào de yèwù jiāo gěi tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very careless in doing things, so the company has never dared to hand important business over to him.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo zuìjìn yòu máng yòu lèi, yīncǐ wǒ tèdì zài cānzhuō shàngtou bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méiguī, ràng tā kāixīn yīxià. Wèile dǎkāi guówài shìchǎng, gōngsī shàngtou juédìng zēngjiā wǎnglù xiāoshòu fāngmiàn de jīngfèi.
examples.english: My wife has been both busy and tired recently, so I specially placed her favorite red roses on top of the dining table to cheer her up a bit. In order to open up overseas markets, the company's higher-ups decided to increase funding for online sales.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的年輕人愛喝咖啡，因此很多地方都是咖啡店比茶館多。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de niánqīngrén ài hē kāfēi, yīncǐ hěn duō dìfāng dōu shì kāfēidiàn bǐ cháguǎn duō.
examples.english: Young people in Taiwan love to drink coffee, so in many places there are more coffee shops than teahouses.

examples.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
examples.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

examples.chinese: 在這個地區，山地是最主要的地形，因此人口較少。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dìqū, shāndì shì zuì zhǔyào de dìxíng, yīncǐ rénkǒu jiào shǎo.
examples.english: In this region, mountainous terrain is the most dominant landform; therefore, the population is relatively small.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 每次有人拜託他幫忙，他都沒拒絕過，因此大家都說他是「好好先生」(yes-man)。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì yǒu rén bàituō tā bāngmáng, tā dōu méi jùjué guò, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì “hǎohǎo xiānshēng”.
examples.english: Every time someone asks him for help, he has never refused, so everyone calls him a "yes-man."

examples.chinese: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngdāng mí nà wèi míngxīng, yīncǐ bùguǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mófǎng tā.
examples.english: He is quite obsessed with that star, so regardless of what he wears or uses, he imitates him.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn bù kèqi, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu lǎn de lǐ tā.
examples.english: He is very impolite to people, so everyone cannot be bothered to pay attention to him.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
examples.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

examples.chinese: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào táocí chájù shì zhuānjiā yǐ shǒugōng fāngshì zuò de, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bù piányí.
examples.english: This ceramic tea set was made by an expert by hand, so the price is not cheap either.

examples.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
examples.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

items.wordHook: Combining 因(cause) and 此(this): 因此 means therefore.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng duì guójiā de gòngxiàn hěn dà, quánguó mínzhòng dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: The president's contribution to the country is great; the people of the whole nation all respect him.

examples.chinese: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu hěn gāo de xuéwèi, zhǐyào yòngxīn yīyàng néng duì guójiā shèhuì yǒu gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Even without a high academic degree, as long as you are dedicated, you can still contribute to the country and society.

items.wordHook: Combining 貢(offer) and 獻(offer): 貢獻 means contribution.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
examples.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

items.wordHook: Combining 布(cloth) and 置(lay out): 布置 means fix up.
Combining 提(carry) and 供(supply): 提供 means provide.
Liquid 氵(water) essence pressed directly 由(from) seeds yields cooking 油(oil).
電(electricity) + 腦(brain): an electric brain → a computer.
